title: Groundnut — Karnataka Specific Package of Practices
content:
KARNATAKA GROUNDNUT PACKAGE OF PRACTICES (UAS Dharwad / UAS Bengaluru):

RECOMMENDED VARIETIES (Karnataka):
- North Karnataka (Dharwad zone): GPBD-4 (kharif, 95 days, high oleic), TAG-24, JL-24
- South Karnataka (Bengaluru zone): GPBD-4, TMV-2, CO-2
- Raichur-Hyderabad Karnataka: GPBD-4, K-134, Narayani

SEED TREATMENT (Karnataka Recommendation):
1. Bavistin (Carbendazim) 2g/kg seed — soilborne disease protection.
2. Thiram 3g/kg seed — if Aspergillus crown rot risk.
3. Rhizobium culture 600g/ha — promotes nitrogen fixation.
4. PSB 600g/ha — phosphorus mobilization.

LAND PREPARATION (Karnataka):
- Red sandy loam: Deep plow 30cm in summer before kharif.
- Black cotton soil: Summer plowing + 2 harrowing before sowing.
- Form ridges 20-25cm height for rainfed areas to prevent waterlogging.

SOWING:
- Kharif (North Karnataka): 1st–2nd week of June.
- Kharif (South Karnataka): 3rd week of June – 1st week of July.
- Rabi (irrigated only): October–November.

KEY AGRONOMIC PRACTICES:
- Earthing up at 30-35 DAS is critical for pegging.
- If soil crust forms, break crust at 7-10 DAS for better germination.
- Thin seedlings to maintain recommended plant population.
